result.reason: Assuming Corio is the Customer, the operative language gives it a 30-day convenience-termination right and requires a refund of prepaid fees allocable to the post-termination period, substantively providing the required pro-rata refund. Commerce One receives no convenience-termination right during a committed term; its existing right is only to prevent renewal at term end. However, adding a right to terminate “in part” exceeds the playbook requirement and may create unnecessary scope and fee-adjustment ambiguity, so the revision is not strictly minimal.
